reviews.text: Training with Reggie has been awesome!  He uses his knowledge of strength and mobility training to develop fun customized workouts specific to your fitness goals. I’ve been training with Reggie again since December and not only am I seeing results but my body’s energy level has drastically improved.  10/10 recommend!
reviews.author: Marisa Price

reviews.text: Reggie is a fantastic trainer! He has increased my athleticism and overall fitness in a short amount of time. I appreciate the focus on flexibility and agility paired with strength training. Would highly recommend Hybrid Flex for all fitness levels - both experienced athletes and beginners can benefit from Reggie’s expertise.
reviews.author: Breah Mack

reviews.text: Reggie is very well versed in strength & conditioning training and mobility & recovery. He is always willing to adjust the workouts towards my personal goals and pushes me to levels I never thought I could reach. I have seen amazing results over the past year and a half while training with Reggie and would strongly recommend him to accomplish your fitness goals!
reviews.author: Maeve Rooney

reviews.text: I’ve been lucky enough to train with Reggie for years now. Having him as a trainer has pushed me to get out of my comfort zone in the gym and test my limits. He has adjusted his training a number of times while helping me get started focusing on my health and fitness, maintain it during pregnancy and bounce back after having a baby. No matter what stage I’ve been at, he has always been reliable and a consistent part of my journey.
reviews.author: Nicole Cooper

reviews.text:
When I first started training with Reggie 2 years ago I had almost no mobility in my hips or my shoulders. I neglected areas that needed to be worked on as an athlete. Immediately him and I went after my weaknesses and improvements started happening. My hips opened up, shoulders became more mobile, my lower back tightness went away and my lifts and performance improved drastically. If you are looking for a professional to improve your mobility as an athlete to help get to the next level Reggie is your guy! Highly recommend him!
Next level trainer right here!
reviews.author: Jonathan Weinstein (Weinsteinfitness)
